body.faq_description: Common questions about custom AI solutions, integration, security and how we work with productised offerings.

faqs.question: What AI solutions does IGENTX offer?
faqs.answer: We offer custom AI integrations including RAG assistants, workflow automation, intelligent product features and API-connected AI workflows. We also provide the AI Customer Service Agent as a ready-to-deploy product for website support and lead capture.

faqs.question: What is the difference between custom AI and your AI Customer Service Agent product?
faqs.answer: The AI Customer Service Agent is a productised website assistant with one-line integration, ideal for 24/7 support and lead capture. Custom AI solutions are scoped to your specific workflows, internal tools, data sources and product requirements. Many clients start with the product and expand into custom integrations as needs grow.

faqs.question: How does RAG work for business AI assistants?
faqs.answer: Retrieval-augmented generation indexes your pages, PDFs, service lists and documents. When a user asks a question, the system retrieves relevant content and generates a grounded response. You control the knowledge base and can update it as your business evolves.

faqs.question: Is your AI multilingual?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build and deploy multilingual AI experiences so visitors and users can get accurate responses in their preferred language. This is valuable for global businesses and teams serving diverse audiences.

faqs.question: Can AI integrate with our existing website or internal tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate AI into websites, customer portals, CRMs and internal dashboards through APIs, webhooks and embedded components. Integration scope depends on your stack and security requirements.

faqs.question: How long does a custom AI project take?
faqs.answer: Productised deployments like the AI Customer Service Agent can be live in under 30 minutes. Custom integrations vary by scope: focused assistants often take 2-4 weeks, while larger workflow automation or product features may take longer. We provide timelines after discovery.

faqs.question: Is AI safe and secure to use?
faqs.answer: We implement secure authentication, domain restrictions and privacy-conscious data handling appropriate to each deployment. For the AI Customer Service Agent, JWT and domain protection help secure the widget. Custom projects follow your compliance and access requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing AI support and optimisation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support knowledge base updates, conversation review, prompt tuning, new integrations and performance monitoring. Ongoing care helps AI stay accurate as your offerings and policies change.
